summary: Implemented allocation-conscious fixed-literal matching across bounded reader blocks using the selected managed SearchValues candidate primitive, ordinal span checks, and bounded prefix-state continuation. Exact spans and source rows match the independent physical-line oracle across every hand-fixture split, patterns longer than blocks, adjacent and EOF-ending matches, randomized inputs and every non-zero chunk size.

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning Search matcher/source, its boundary tests and scanner documentation were changed. No sibling repository, query-engine adapter, public source signature, release, publish or install surface was modified.
implementation.backend: System.Buffers.SearchValues<char> locates first-code-unit candidates; ordinal ReadOnlySpan<char>.SequenceEqual validates complete in-block candidates.
implementation.boundaryState: Candidates reaching a block end retain KMP matched-prefix state, prefix table and a literal-sized coordinate ring. A later block emits a completed span once, then matching resumes after its end.
implementation.blockOwnership: Complete in-block matches are emitted from the current block; cross-block matches are emitted by the block that consumes their final code unit. Skipped runs advance absolute UTF-16 offsets and physical-line coordinates without row materialization.
implementation.recordSemantics: Physical newlines terminate records and discard partial state. Literals containing a newline produce no physical-record spans, matching the independent reference scanner.
implementation.ownership: The source retains W05-S01's single bounded pooled reader buffer. Matcher state is pattern-sized; emitted rows retain only scalar coordinates and immutable strings.

requiredCoverage: every possible split of a hand-written content fixture
patterns longer than every supplied matcher block
adjacent matches and matches ending at EOF
48 deterministic randomized inputs with every chunk size from 1 through each input length
real Search source rows from irregular reader blocks

gateResults.evidence: The exact owning-repository Release suite exited 0 with 21 projects, 1,369 discovered, 1,335 passed, 0 failed and 34 skips; the focused Search suite exited 0 with 82 passed and 3 platform-conditional skips.

The separate ownership review approved the selected primitive, bounded continuation state, physical-line behavior and retained-row contract; exact source/artifact hashes and the unique trailer-bearing completion commit are verified during post-commit finalization.

The independent oracle agrees with exact matcher spans for every hand-fixture split, patterns longer than blocks, adjacent/EOF matches, physical-line boundaries and 48 randomized inputs at every non-zero chunk size; real source rows also agree.

The matcher retains only pattern-sized state, advances coordinates through skipped blocks, checks cancellation during block consumption, and preserves the pooled-buffer/owned-row lifecycle from W05-S01.

knownLimitations: Matcher state and the temporary per-block span list are bounded by literal length and the fixed reader block/hit count; native grep integration, byte matching, regex and multi-pattern sharing remain later scopes.
The current row source still materializes owned SearchMatch objects for emitted occurrences; nonmatches do not allocate row objects.
The repository-wide suite retains 31 existing expected skips, 3 platform-conditional symlink skips and existing compiler/package-audit warnings; no package was published.
